Last Time · Explain & Apply

Last Time: Plan A / Plan B

󾠮 Explain: When do you switch from Plan A to Plan B?

󾠯 Apply: You're at the register. A long line forms. You can't leave.

What do you do?

󾠰 Apply: Say your Plan A and your Plan B.

Last Time · Answers

Check: Last Time

🔄 Switch when I can't do Plan A here, or I tried it and it didn't help.

🛒 Use a quiet tool right there (box breathing, squeeze and release).

Tell the boss at break.

🅱 Asking an adult always counts as a Plan B.

Review Game

Which Tool Fits?

Read the scene.

Vote 1, 2, or 3 on your fingers.

Tell us WHY it fits.

🃏 Card 1 of 4

Quiet test. Your heart is racing.

󾠮 Box breathing   Cold water   Reset pass

✅ Answer · Card 1 of 4 ✅

󾠮 Box Breathing!

It's silent and you can do it at your desk.

Other tools can work too. Say why!

🃏 Card 2 of 4

A mean comment online. You think,

“Everyone hates me.”

󾠮 Squeeze and release   Cool thoughts   5-4-3-2-1

✅ Answer · Card 2 of 4 ✅

󾠯 Cool Thoughts!

Change the thought: “One comment isn't everyone.”

Other tools can work too. Say why!

🃏 Card 3 of 4

After PE. You're hot, red, and angry.

󾠮 Cool thoughts   Box breathing   Cold water

✅ Answer · Card 3 of 4 ✅

󾠰 Cold Water!

Cold water cools your body down fast.

Other tools can work too. Say why!

🃏 Card 4 of 4

Crowded hallway. Too much noise. You

can't think.

󾠮 5-4-3-2-1 grounding   Cold water   Cool thoughts

✅ Answer · Card 4 of 4 ✅

󾠮 5-4-3-2-1!

Grounding brings you back to right now.

Other tools can work too. Say why!
